sf.label: Stockfish 19
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at every position, 10M nodes, last completed iteration. Candidate comparisons (60M nodes) and deep checks (200M nodes) restrict the root moves and keep their own budgets.

notes.text: After 47...Kd6, 48.Rd3+ gains time to activate White’s rook. In a depth-27 local line, 48...Kc6 49.Rc3+ leads to a favorable rook trade for White; 47...Kf7 keeps the black king away from the check. A single historical CDB snapshot suggested a bigger difference; current CDB has not been checked.
Stockfish 19, 16 Nov 2026 (1 thread, 200M nodes, depth 34, deep check): Kf7 −0.57, played Kd6 −6.20 (mover POV). The catalog alternative is better by 5.63 pawns.
